meta.name: Headline Editor
meta.description: Player mixes 3 independent tag dimensions (Audience x Tone x Engagement) to generate headlines from the same set of facts, revealing that the LLM never evaluates fairness — it just follows framing.

audience.label: Worker / Union
audience.description: Cares about job security and livelihoods.
audience.prompt_fragment: Write for supermarket workers and trade union members who are worried about job losses.

audience.label: Consumer
audience.prompt_fragment: Write for everyday shoppers who care about prices, speed, and convenience.

audience.label: Investor / Business
audience.description: Cares about efficiency, cost-cutting, and stock performance.
audience.prompt_fragment: Write for investors and business readers who care about operational efficiency and company performance.

tone.label: Neutral / Measured
tone.prompt_fragment: Use a neutral, measured, factual tone.

engagement.label: Straightforward
engagement.prompt_fragment: State the news plainly, no rhetorical tricks.

engagement.label: Breaking / Urgent
engagement.prompt_fragment: Frame it as breaking, urgent news demanding immediate attention.

engagement.label: Provocative Question
engagement.prompt_fragment: Phrase the headline as a provocative question that hooks the reader.

example_scenario.facts: A major supermarket chain announced the expansion of AI self-checkout to all stores nationwide. 40% of existing cashier positions will be eliminated. The company claims the move will reduce operating costs and may lower prices for consumers. Trade unions have raised concerns about reemployment prospects for affected workers.
